title: Character Pose Grid
description: A 4x6 grid of 24 identical female figures shown in various angles against solid colored backgrounds. Each panel features the same woman in a patterned turquoise and orange dress with a green headwrap, surrounded by glowing ethereal bubble and swirl effects.
prompt: A 4x6 grid of a young black woman with green headwrap and patterned turquoise-orange dress, displayed in multiple angles including front, side, and back views. Each cell has a different solid background color with glowing translucent bubble and swirl aura effects surrounding her. Clean studio lighting, consistent character design across all 24 poses.
